text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for chart=service-external v2.3.1 in eu-west-1 (canary=5%). Preflight check: detected service-account token rotation -> pod evictions observed. Holding canary. refs: deploy/7789

alex: saw the hold. is this the SA rotation we scheduled?

maria: yes, we rotated external-service SA tokens at 02:00 UTC for audit reasons. expected, but we did not coordinate with live canaries. sorry, my bad. :grimacing:

samir: ok — options: (A) pin promotion to previous chart v2.3.0 and unpin after fix, (B) rollback the canary, (C) hotfix chart to include secret-rollout hook and continue. thoughts?

sre-oncall: can we see the k8s events? quick check: 
```
$ kubectl -n payments get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 10
WARNING  Eviction created for pod/service-external-canary-1: failed to mount secret: secret sync pending
Normal   SecretUpdated  secret/external-service-token rotated
```

maria: the secret update annotation is `token-rotation=true`. rollout controller is updating secrets but some nodes see the old token until sidecar restarts. helm chart doesn't wait for secret update.

alex: given change window (ends 03:30 UTC) and customer-facing traffic, prefer pin to v2.3.0 so we don't expand blast radius.

jen: +1 to pin. We can schedule a hotfix for 03:45 and re-promote after verification. Want release note line: "hotfix planned for token rotation graceful rollout". Also need deploybot annotation so we don't auto-promote.

maria: I'll open a PR for the hook. sample values override we can use in hotfix: 
```
serviceExternal:
  rollout:
    waitForSecret: true
    secretSelector: external-service-token
    postHookSleepSec: 10
```

samir: I'll apply a manual pin to chart v2.3.0 for the promotion pipeline: `deploybot annotate release=service-external pin=v2.3.0 reason="secret rotation causing evictions"`

ops-bot: Action recorded: release annotation added by samir at 1728888055. Promotion pipeline will skip v2.3.1 and pin to v2.3.0.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: chart pinned to v2.3.0 (by samir). Canary rollout cancelled for v2.3.1.

sre-oncall: good call. opened incident ticket INF-4021 to track hotfix verification and customers impacted.

alex: please add a short line in Friday's release notes and ping support. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
